subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which linked implementation should be treated as canonical for generating the SecretRef reference docs, and should the other open PR be closed or refreshed?
rationale: Current main still has the reported gap, but two open PRs already target the same issue, so opening another automated fix would add duplicate work instead of resolving ownership.

options.title: Refresh and review the stronger proven PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical implementation if maintainers accept its scope, then close or supersede the overlapping PR.

options.title: Revive the same-author closing PR
options.body: Ask the author of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 to refresh conflicts and add real behavior proof before it remains the closing path.

options.title: Close both and request a narrower replacement
options.body: Use this only if neither open branch matches the desired generator/check shape after maintainer review.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review the stronger proven PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical implementation if maintainers accept its scope, then close or supersede the overlapping PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SecretRef docs stabilization and current maintenance history make this the best available owner for choosing the canonical implementation path.
